repos.name: cmd-current-account-lifecycle
repos.description: Handles opening authorization, state transitions (Active, Frozen, Dormant, Closed). js 20, Lambda, DynamoDB Write Table 'core-accounts-master'.

repos.name: cmd-current-account-deposits
repos.description: Ingestion and validation of direct cash/cheque deposits.

repos.name: cmd-current-account-overdraft
repos.description: Evaluates and triggers automated overdraft drawdowns. 22 Lambda.

repos.name: qry-current-account-details
repos.description: Sub-10ms query service for account metadata, state, limits. js Lambda, Redis Cache / DynamoDB Read Replica.

repos.name: qry-current-account-statements
repos.description: Serves historical PDF and JSON statements.

repos.name: prj-current-account-readmodel
repos.description: Consumes 'AccountCreated', 'AccountStatusChanged' events from EventBridge; writes to DynamoDB Global Read Table. js Lambda.

repos.name: prj-current-account-analytics
repos.description: Pushes account status telemetry to OpenSearch and S3 Parquet Lake.

repos.name: sfn-current-account-closure-saga
repos.description: Step Function state machine orchestrating account closure, fee clearance, balance zeroing, and legal release.

repos.name: plug-host-mainframe-core-sync
repos.description: Bi-directional SNA/TCP connector to IBM Mainframe DB2 Core Banking.

repos.name: alm-current-account-errors
repos.description: CloudWatch alarms for 5xx spikes, DB lock timeouts, and DLQ backlogs on account lifecycle events.

repos.name: cmd-payment-execution-initiate
repos.description: Ingests payment orders, validates idempotency key, executes schema validation. js 20 Lambda.

repos.name: cmd-payment-execution-authorization
repos.description: Enforces authorization rules, multi-factor token signatures.

repos.name: cmd-payment-execution-settle
repos.description: Executes final settlement confirmation and releases transaction locks.

repos.name: qry-payment-execution-status
repos.description: Read API polling and webhook queries for transfer status. js Lambda, DynamoDB.

repos.name: qry-payment-execution-limits
repos.description: Calculates remaining daily and per-transaction limits. js Lambda, Redis Cache.

repos.name: prj-payment-execution-history
repos.description: Projects all payment lifecycle events into the unified payment timeline store.

repos.name: prj-payment-execution-metrics
repos.description: Emits Prometheus/CloudWatch metrics for transaction throughput, success rate, and latency.

repos.name: sfn-payment-instant-transfer-saga
repos.description: Critical distributed Saga: 1. Hold Funds in Source -> 2. Risk Check -> 3. Credit Target -> 4. Release Hold. Automated compensation on timeout.

repos.name: sfn-payment-clearing-cce-saga
repos.description: Batch and scheduled clearing orchestration with Chamber of Clearing (CCE).

repos.name: plug-cce-clearing-ingress
repos.description: Receives inbound payment batches from domestic clearinghouse via AS2/HTTPS.

repos.name: plug-swift-iso20022-connector
repos.description: Translates ISO 20022 pacs.008, pacs.002 messages to internal JSON domain events.

repos.name: alm-payment-execution-p99-latency
repos.description: Alarms on P99 latency exceeding 250ms, triggering automated incident alert to PagerDuty.

repos.name: cmd-party-routing-register
repos.description: Binds mobile phone number (MSISDN) and email to primary Account Number (CCI). js Lambda.

repos.name: cmd-party-routing-deregister
repos.description: Unlinks alias or updates account destination. js Lambda.

repos.name: qry-party-routing-resolve
repos.description: Ultra-fast directory lookup (resolves phone number to bank routing and account in <15ms).

repos.name: prj-party-routing-directory
repos.description: Materializes lookup cache across multi-region tables.

repos.name: plug-directory-federation-bridge
repos.description: Connects with interbank directory federation (CCE / BCRP rails). js ECS.

repos.name: alm-party-routing-lookup-failures
repos.description: Monitors resolution failure rates and cache misses.

repos.name: cmd-customer-onboarding-initiate
repos.description: Receives digital prospect application and initiates KYC workflow.

repos.name: cmd-customer-onboarding-biometrics
repos.description: Ingests facial validation payload and RENIEC biometric token.

repos.name: qry-customer-onboarding-progress
repos.description: Returns real-time state of applicant progress for mobile app. js Lambda.

repos.name: prj-customer-onboarding-funnel
repos.description: Projects funnel conversion drop-offs into analytics lake.

repos.name: sfn-customer-onboarding-saga
repos.description: Orchestrates KYC -> AML Validation -> Contract Generation -> Account Creation -> Debit Card Provisioning.

repos.name: plug-reniec-biometrics-gateway
repos.description: Connects to national identity registry (RENIEC) with TLS mutual auth.

repos.name: plug-experian-credit-score
repos.description: Pulls credit score and risk bureau data.

repos.name: alm-onboarding-kyc-drop-rate
repos.description: Alarms if KYC validation failures exceed 8% threshold.

repos.name: cmd-customer-agreement-sign
repos.description: Records digital signature, cryptographic hash, and legal consent timestamp. js Lambda.

repos.name: cmd-customer-agreement-amend
repos.description: Applies contractual annexes, interest rate changes, or clause updates.

repos.name: qry-customer-agreement-fetch
repos.description: Retrieves signed legal terms and audit certificate. js Lambda, S3 presigned URLs.

repos.name: prj-customer-agreement-indexer
repos.description: Indexes contract clauses and consent history into OpenSearch.

repos.name: plug-docusign-legal-trust-bridge
repos.description: Integrates with certified digital signature provider for legal stamping.

repos.name: alm-agreement-compliance-gaps
repos.description: Tracks missing required terms and condition acceptances.

repos.name: cmd-position-keeping-reserve
repos.description: Places temporary authorization holds on balances for card swipe or pending transfer.

repos.name: cmd-position-keeping-release
repos.description: Releases or commits hold into settled balance.

repos.name: qry-position-keeping-realtime-balance
repos.description: Provides instantaneous available, ledger, and hold balances.

repos.name: qry-position-keeping-movements
repos.description: Returns paginated transaction movements and timestamps. js Lambda.

repos.name: prj-position-keeping-ledger-view
repos.description: Listens to debit/credit posted events to maintain continuous balance snapshots.

repos.name: prj-position-keeping-audit-balance
repos.description: Daily balance delta projection against core mainframe reports.

repos.name: plug-atm-switch-pos-gateway
repos.description: ISO 8583 translator for ATM switches and POS debit authorizations.

repos.name: alm-position-keeping-balance-discrepancy
repos.description: Critical P0 Alarm: triggers on any ledger vs available balance mathematical mismatch.

repos.name: cmd-financial-accounting-voucher
repos.description: Creates double-entry debits and credits ledger vouchers.

repos.name: qry-financial-accounting-trail
repos.description: Inquires chart of accounts balances and journal entries. js Lambda.

repos.name: prj-financial-accounting-journal
repos.description: Stream-aggregates all financial transaction events into the general ledger journal.

repos.name: prj-financial-accounting-eod-balance
repos.description: Compiles End-of-Day balance totals per currency (PEN, USD).

repos.name: sfn-financial-accounting-eod-reconciliation
repos.description: Step Function running at 23:59:00 to lock daily balances, reconcile with central ledger, and produce balance sheet vouchers.

repos.name: plug-sap-erp-general-ledger-adapter
repos.description: Transmits daily accounting journals into SAP S/4HANA via RFC/OData.

repos.name: alm-general-ledger-unbalanced-voucher
repos.description: High-priority alarm triggered if Total Debits != Total Credits.

repos.name: cmd-collateral-allocation-pledge
repos.description: Pledges term deposits or accounts as collateral against lines of credit. js Lambda.

repos.name: cmd-collateral-allocation-release
repos.description: Releases collateral hold upon loan discharge.

repos.name: qry-collateral-allocation-status
repos.description: Checks collateral coverage ratio and pledged assets. js Lambda.

repos.name: prj-collateral-allocation-exposure
repos.description: Projects real-time risk exposure of linked credit lines.

repos.name: alm-collateral-under-coverage-warning
repos.description: Alarms when collateral value falls below loan margin ratio.

repos.name: cmd-fraud-detection-evaluate-tx
repos.description: Evaluates transaction risk score in real time using rules engine and ML model.

repos.name: cmd-fraud-detection-lockout
repos.description: Executes preventative security freeze on compromised cards and accounts. js Lambda.

repos.name: qry-fraud-detection-risk-profile
repos.description: Reads customer behavioral risk indicators, device fingerprint history.

repos.name: prj-fraud-detection-blacklists
repos.description: Synchronizes international OFAC, PEP, and suspicious account blacklists.

repos.name: sfn-fraud-suspicious-alert-investigation
repos.description: Escalates high-risk transaction cases to fraud operations squad, alerts user, and monitors feedback.

repos.name: plug-device-fingerprint-threatmetrix
repos.description: Ingests device telemetry, IP reputation, and biometrics signals from LexisNexis/ThreatMetrix. js Lambda.

repos.name: plug-biocatch-behavioral-engine
repos.description: Ingests mobile screen interaction dynamics and behavioral telemetry.

repos.name: alm-fraud-high-risk-spike-alarm
repos.description: Alarms on sudden surges of high-risk transactions in specific BIN or geography.

repos.name: cmd-customer-alert-dispatch
repos.description: Routes transactional notifications according to customer channel preferences. js Lambda.

repos.name: qry-customer-alert-delivery-status
repos.description: Inquires delivery status, open rates, and push delivery receipts.

repos.name: prj-customer-alert-audit-log
repos.description: Records notification compliance records (timestamp, recipient, payload hash).

repos.name: plug-fcm-apns-push-gateway
repos.description: Apple APNS & Google FCM mobile push connector.

repos.name: plug-twilio-infobip-sms-gateway
repos.description: High-throughput SMS and WhatsApp business API gateway. js ECS.

repos.name: qry-audit-log-trace-inspector
